completeness_prompt.value: A timestamp proves WHEN, not WHAT. Add who/what/why (e.g., "lunch w/ J. Rivera re: Q3 site contract") — generic purposes do not meet the §274(d) substantiation standard and stay out of the Defense File until corrected.
